rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and Its Affiliated Agencies” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing quotas for auxiliary and advisory agencies established in the Ministry of Planning and Budget and its affiliated agencies, the establishment of auxiliaryagencies and advisory agencies equivalent thereto placed under directors and bureau chiefs pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the “Government Organization Act,” and the division of duties.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and Its Affiliated Agencies” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing quotas for auxiliary and advisory agencies established in the Ministry of Planning and Budget and its affiliated agencies, the establishment of auxiliary agencies and advisory agencies equivalent thereto placed under directors and bureau chiefs pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the “Government Organization Act,” and the division of duties.

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Policy Advisor to the Minister) One of the Policy Advisors to the Minister shall be appointed as a special-category public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of such position shall be Grade B. rows.source_ko: 제4조의2(국고보조금관리단장) ① 국고보조금관리단장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4-2 (Head of the National Treasury Subsidy Management Agency) ① The Head of the National Treasury Subsidy Management Agency shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 국고보조금관리단장 밑에 국고보조금총괄담당관 및 국고보조금점검담당관 각 1명을 두되, 각 담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② One General Manager of National Treasury Subsidies and one Manager of National Treasury Subsidy Inspection shall be appointed under the Head of the National Treasury Subsidy Management Group, and each manager shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, a Secretary of Science and Technology, or a Secretary.

rows.source_ko: ③ 국고보조금총괄담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 국고보조금관리단장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The General Manager of National Treasury Subsidies assists the Director of the National Treasury Subsidy Management Group with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 「보조금 관리에 관한 법률」 제26조의2제1항에 따른 보조금통합관리망(이하 “보조금통합관리망”이라 한다)의 운영과 관련된 국고보조금 부정수급 방지 및 관리ㆍ집행체계 개선을 위한 정책ㆍ법령ㆍ제도의 수립ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and coordination of policies , laws, and systems for the prevention of fraudulent receipt of state subsidies and the improvement of the management and execution system related to the operation of the Integrated Subsidy Management Network ( hereinafter referred to as the “Integrated Subsidy Management Network”) pursuant to Article 26-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Management of Subsidies.

rows.source_ko: 2. 보조금통합관리망의 운영과 관련된 부처별ㆍ분야별 국고보조금 부정수급 방지체계 수립 및 운영기준 마련
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of a system to prevent fraudulent receipt of state subsidies by ministry and sector and preparation of operational standards related to the operation of the Integrated Subsidy Management Network

rows.source_ko: 3. 보조금통합관리망의 운영과 관련된 부처별ㆍ분야별 국고보조금 관리ㆍ집행체계의 이행 여부 확인ㆍ점검 및 그 결과의 활용
rows.text_en: 3. Verification and inspection of the implementation of the national subsidy management and execution system by ministry and sector related to the operation of the Integrated Subsidy Management Network, and utilization of the results

rows.source_ko: 4. 보조금통합관리망의 관리 및 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Management and Operation of the Integrated Subsidy Management Network

rows.source_ko: 5. 보조금통합관리망을 통한 국고보조금 교부ㆍ집행ㆍ정산ㆍ반납 및 사후관리의 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Operation and Management of the Disbursement, Execution, Settlement, Return, and Post-Management of State Subsidies through the Integrated Subsidy Management Network

rows.source_ko: 6. 국고보조금 또는 국고보조사업에 관한 인터넷 기반의 대국민 포털 구축ㆍ운영ㆍ관리 및 활용 촉진
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment, operation, management, and promotion of utilization of an internet-based public portal regarding state subsidies or state subsidy projects

rows.source_ko: 7. 국고보조금 부정수급 의심사업 점검 및 현장조사ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 7. Inspection, On-site Investigation, and Management of Projects Suspected of Fraudulent Receipt of Government Subsidies

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 국고보조금 부정수급 방지에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters concerning the prevention of fraudulent receipt of government subsidies

rows.text_en: ④ The National Treasury Subsidy Inspection Officer assists the Head of the National Treasury Subsidy Management Group with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 보조금통합관리망을 통한 부정수급 모니터링

rows.source_ko: 2. 국고보조금 부정수급 의심사업 점검 및 현장조사ㆍ관리 총괄
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management of inspections, on-site investigations, and operations for projects suspected of fraudulent receipt of government subsidies

rows.source_ko: 3. 국고보조금 부정수급 적발사업의 이견 조정 및 시스템 등록 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Mediation of disagreements and management of system registration regarding projects involving the detection of fraudulent receipt of government subsidies

rows.source_ko: 4. 보조금관리위원회에 두는 소위원회의 운영 및 심의결과 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Operation of subcommittees within the Subsidy Management Committee and management of deliberation results

rows.source_ko: 5. 국고보조금 부정수급 적발사업에 대한 환수ㆍ제재 등 후속조치 이행상황 점검 및 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Monitoring and management of the implementation status of follow-up measures, such as recovery and sanctions, for projects found to have received government subsidies fraudulently.

rows.source_ko: 6. 국고보조금 부정수급 대응 및 방지를 위하여 각 중앙행정기관에 두는 위원회의 심의결과에 대한 적정성 점검
rows.text_en: 6. Verification of the appropriateness of deliberation results by committees established in each central administrative agency to respond to and prevent fraudulent receipt of state subsidies

rows.text_en: Article 5 (Audit Officer) The Audit Officer shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretaries, or Secretaries.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(운영지원과) 운영지원과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Operations Support Division) The Head of the Operations Support Division shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(미래전략기획실) ① 미래전략기획실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Future Strategy Planning Office) ① The Head of the Future Strategy Planning Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「기획예산처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제10조제1항에 따라 미래전략기획실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 성장기획정책관, 통합성장정책관, 재정혁신정책관 및 재정참여정책관으로 하며, 성장기획정책관, 통합성장정책관, 재정혁신정책관 및 재정참여정책관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Head of the Future Strategy Planning Office shall be the Director of Growth Planning Policy, the Director of Integrated Growth Policy, the Director of Fiscal Innovation Policy, and the Director of Fiscal Participation Policy; the Director of Growth Planning Policy, the Director of Integrated Growth Policy, the Director of Fiscal Innovation Policy, and the Director of Fiscal Participation Policy shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the positions shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 성장기획정책관은 「기획예산처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제10조제3항제1호부터 제12호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of Growth Planning Policy assists the Director with matters under subparagraphs 1 through 12 of Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and Its Affiliated Agencies.”

rows.source_ko: ④ 통합성장정책관은 「기획예산처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제10조제3항제13호부터 제23호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of Integrated Growth Policy assists the Director with matters under subparagraphs 13 through 23 of Article 10 , Paragraph 3 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and Its Affiliated Agencies.”

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 재정혁신정책관은 「기획예산처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제10조제3항제24호부터 제40호까지, 제42호부터 제47호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director of Fiscal Innovation Policy assists the Director with respect to matters under Article 10, Paragraph 3 , Subparagraphs 24 through 40 and 42 through 47 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and Its Affiliated Agencies.”

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 재정참여정책관은 「기획예산처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제10조제3항제41호, 제48호부터 제60호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Director of Fiscal Participation Policy assists the Director with respect to matters under Article 10, Paragraph 3 , Subparagraphs 41 , 48 through 60 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and Its Affiliated Agencies.”

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 미래전략기획실에 미래전략과ㆍ혁신경제전환과ㆍ탄소중립정책과ㆍ포용사회전략과ㆍ인구구조혁신과ㆍ상생협력전략과ㆍ재정혁신총괄과ㆍ지속가능재정과ㆍ재정기획분석과ㆍ지출혁신과ㆍ재정협력총괄과ㆍ국제재정협력과 및 열린재정정보과를 두되, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Future Strategy Planning Office shall have the Future Strategy Division, the Innovation Economy Transition Division, the Carbon Neutrality Policy Division, the Inclusive Society Strategy Division, the Population Structure Innovation Division, the Win-Win Cooperation Strategy Division, the Fiscal Innovation General Division, the Sustainable Finance Division, the Fiscal Planning and Analysis Division, the Expenditure Innovation Division, the Fiscal Cooperation General Division, the International Fiscal Cooperation Division, and the Open Fiscal Information Division, and each division head shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, a Science and Technology Secretary, or a Secretary.

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 미래전략과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of Future Strategy is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 중장기 국가발전전략 수립 업무 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of the formulation of mid-to-long-term national development strategies

rows.source_ko: 2. 국가 미래비전 기획 및 수립
rows.text_en: 2. Planning and Establishment of National Future Vision

rows.source_ko: 3. 중장기 국가발전을 위한 경제정책 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation and coordination of economic policies for mid-to-long-term national development

rows.source_ko: 4. 국정기획 및 국정과제 관리 기획
rows.text_en: 4. Planning for State Affairs Planning and Management of State Tasks

rows.source_ko: 5. 미래 대내외 변화 추세 예측ㆍ분석 및 전략적 활용 방안 개발
rows.text_en: 5. Prediction and Analysis of Future Domestic and External Change Trends and Development of Strategic Utilization Plans

rows.source_ko: 6. 미래 리스크 관리ㆍ대응
rows.text_en: 6. Future Risk Management and Response

rows.source_ko: 7. 경제 분야 중장기 위험요인 분석 및 대응전략 수립의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 7. Overall management and coordination of the analysis of mid-to-long-term risk factors in the economic sector and the establishment of response strategies

rows.source_ko: 8. 분야별 중장기 계획의 기획ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 8. Planning and overall management of mid-to-long-term plans by sector

rows.source_ko: 9. 중장기 성장잠재력 확충 전략 수립
rows.text_en: 9. Establishment of a strategy to enhance mid-to-long-term growth potential

rows.source_ko: 10. 「중장기전략위원회 규정」에 따른 중장기전략위원회 운영
rows.text_en: 10. Operation of the Mid-to-Long-Term Strategy Committee pursuant to the "Regulations on the Mid-to-Long-Term Strategy Committee"

rows.source_ko: 11. 그 밖에 실 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other departments within the building

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 혁신경제전환과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Innovation Economy Transition Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 산업의 균형발전과 경쟁력강화를 위한 기본방향의 수립 및 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of basic directions for balanced industrial development and strengthening of competitiveness, and consultation and coordination of related policies

rows.source_ko: 2. 중장기 국가발전을 위한 산업 관련 주요 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Consultation and coordination of major industry-related policies for mid-to-long-term national development

rows.source_ko: 3. 인공지능 등 경제구조 전환 전략의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation and coordination of strategies for economic structural transformation, including artificial intelligence

rows.source_ko: 4. 과학기술ㆍ에너지ㆍ자원개발 관련 주요 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation and coordination of major policies related to science and technology, energy, and resource development

rows.source_ko: 5. 기후대응 및 녹색전환 등 경제구조 전환 전략의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation and coordination of strategies for economic structural transformation, including climate response and green transition

rows.source_ko: 6. 제조업 및 농업ㆍ임업ㆍ수산업 관련 주요 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Consultation and coordination of major policies related to the manufacturing industry and agriculture, forestry, and fisheries

rows.source_ko: 7. 서비스업 관련 시책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 7. Consultation and coordination of policies related to the service industry

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 경제구조 전환과 관련된 실 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters related to the transition of the economic structure that do not fall under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the office

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 탄소중립정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 10. The Head of the Carbon Neutrality Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 기후위기 대응 및 탄소중립을 위한 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Consultation and coordination of policies for climate crisis response and carbon neutrality

rows.source_ko: 2. 「기후위기 대응을 위한 탄소중립ㆍ녹색성장 기본법 시행령」 제3조제2항에 따른 중장기 국가 온실가스 감축 목표, 부문별 온실가스 감축 목표 및 연도별 온실가스 감축 목표의 설정ㆍ변경 관련 협의
rows.text_en: 2. Consultation regarding the establishment and modification of mid-to-long-term national greenhouse gas reduction targets, sectoral greenhouse gas reduction targets, and annual greenhouse gas reduction targets pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Carbon Neutrality and Green Growth for Response to Climate Crisis

rows.source_ko: 3. 온실가스 배출권거래제 관련 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation and Coordination Regarding the Greenhouse Gas Emission Trading System

rows.source_ko: 4. 「온실가스 배출권의 할당 및 거래에 관한 법률」 제7조제2항에 따른 할당위원회의 구성 및 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Composition and operation of the Allocation Committee pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 2 of the Act on the Allocation and Trading of Greenhouse Gas Emission Allowances

rows.source_ko: 5. 탄소중립 관련 재정정책 및 제도 개선 과제 연구ㆍ개선
rows.text_en: 5. Research and Improvement of Fiscal Policy and Institutional Improvement Tasks Related to Carbon Neutrality

rows.source_ko: 6. 기후위기 대응 및 탄소중립 관련 재원 조성 및 운용 등 재정지원 사항의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Consultation and coordination of financial support matters, including the raising and management of funds related to climate crisis response and carbon neutrality

rows.source_ko: 7. 한국형 자발적 탄소크레딧 생산 및 거래 등에 대한 정책 수립
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment of policies regarding the production and trading of Korean-style voluntary carbon credits, etc.

rows.source_ko: 8. 환경ㆍ사회ㆍ지배구조(ESG: Environmental, Social and Governance) 확산을 위한 인프라 구축 등 관련 정책의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 8. Overall management and coordination of related policies, including the establishment of infrastructure for the expansion of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG).

rows.source_ko: 9. 녹색성장 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 9. Consultation and coordination of policies related to green growth

rows.source_ko: 10. 국민생활 및 안전 관련 환경규제 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 10. Consultation and Coordination of Environmental Regulations Related to Public Life and Safety

rows.source_ko: 11. 기후에너지환경부 소관 환경산업 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 11. Consultation and coordination of policies related to the environmental industry under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment

rows.source_ko: 12. 그 밖에 기후위기 대응 및 탄소중립과 관련된 실 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Other matters related to climate crisis response and carbon neutrality that do not fall under the jurisdiction of other departments within the office

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 포용사회전략과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 11 The Head of the Inclusive Society Strategy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 통합성장 관련 사회분야 중장기 국가발전전략 수립 업무 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of the formulation of mid-to-long-term national development strategies for the social sector related to integrated growth

rows.source_ko: 2. 통합성장 관련 사회분야 중장기 위험요인 분석 및 대응전략 수립의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Overall management and coordination of the analysis of mid-to-long-term risk factors in the social sector related to integrated growth and the establishment of response strategies

rows.source_ko: 3. 양극화 해소 및 사회안전망 강화 등 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation and coordination of related policies, such as resolving polarization and strengthening the social safety net

rows.source_ko: 4. 지역 균형발전 및 경제 활성화를 위한 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation and coordination of policies for balanced regional development and economic revitalization

rows.source_ko: 5. 재정정책과 관련된 노동시장 및 일자리 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation and coordination of labor market and employment policies related to fiscal policy

rows.source_ko: 6. 재정정책과 관련된 교육정책 및 제도의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Consultation and coordination of education policies and systems related to fiscal policy

rows.source_ko: 7. 재정정책과 관련된 보건ㆍ의료 및 주요 복지 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 7. Consultation and coordination of health, medical, and major welfare policies related to fiscal policy

rows.source_ko: 8. 포용경제 민관 협력 거버넌스 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment and Operation of Public-Private Cooperation Governance for an Inclusive Economy

rows.source_ko: 9. 포용경제 종합지표 개발ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 9. Development and Management of Comprehensive Indicators for the Inclusive Economy

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 사회 및 복지와 관련된 실 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Other matters related to society and welfare that do not fall under the jurisdiction of other departments within the office

rows.source_ko: ⑫ 인구구조혁신과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 12 The Head of Population Structure Innovation is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 인구구조 변화 대응 등 지속가능한 경제성장을 위한 전략의 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Formulation of strategies for sustainable economic growth, including responding to demographic changes

rows.source_ko: 2. 인구구조 변화의 영향 및 대응 관련 연구와 국내외 사례 조사ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Impact and Response to Population Structure Changes and Investigation and Analysis of Domestic and International Cases

rows.source_ko: 3. 인구구조 변화 대응 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation and coordination of policies related to responding to demographic changes

rows.source_ko: 4. 인구구조 변화에 따른 세대 간 갈등 예방 및 상생ㆍ통합 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation and coordination of policies for preventing intergenerational conflict and promoting coexistence and integration resulting from demographic changes

rows.source_ko: 5. 인구구조 변화 대응을 위한 외국인정책 관련 중장기 전략의 수립 및 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment of mid-to-long-term strategies regarding foreigner policies to respond to demographic changes and consultation and coordination of related policies

rows.source_ko: 6. 인구구조 변화 대응을 위한 협의체의 운영
rows.text_en: 6. Operation of the Consultative Body for Responding to Changes in Population Structure

rows.source_ko: 7. 저출산ㆍ고령화 관련 정책의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 7. Consultation and coordination of policies related to low birth rates and aging

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 인구 관련 정책에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters concerning population-related policies

rows.source_ko: ⑬ 상생협력전략과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 13. The Head of the Win-Win Cooperation Strategy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 대ㆍ중소기업, 소상공인 등 상생협력 관련 중장기 전략의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Consultation and coordination of mid-to-long-term strategies related to win-win cooperation among large and small businesses, micro-enterprises, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 사회적 자본의 육성에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the fostering of social capital

rows.source_ko: 3. 사회연대경제 관련 정책의 협의
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation on policies related to the social solidarity economy

rows.source_ko: 4. 협동조합 활성화 정책의 장ㆍ단기 계획 수립 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of long-term and short-term plans and overall management and coordination of cooperative revitalization policies

rows.source_ko: 5. 협동조합 관련 법령의 제정ㆍ개정 및 제도 개선 사항 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management and coordination of matters regarding the enactment and amendment of laws and regulations related to cooperatives and institutional improvements

rows.source_ko: 6. 협동조합 실태조사 실시, 통계개발ㆍ관리, 정보시스템 구축 등 협동조합 인프라 구축에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the establishment of cooperative infrastructure, such as conducting surveys on the status of cooperatives, developing and managing statistics, and building information systems

rows.source_ko: 7. 협동조합연합회ㆍ사회적협동조합ㆍ사회적협동조합연합회ㆍ이종협동조합연합회의 설립신고ㆍ인가 및 감독(경영공시를 포함한다)에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the notification of establishment, authorization, and supervision (including management disclosure) of cooperative federations, social cooperatives, social cooperative federations, and heterogeneous cooperative federations

rows.source_ko: 8. 「협동조합 기본법」의 해석 및 협동조합 운영을 위한 지침의 마련ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 8. Interpretation of the Framework Act on Cooperatives and Preparation and Operation of Guidelines for Cooperative Operation

rows.source_ko: 9. 협동조합정책심의위원회의 구성ㆍ운영, 지방자치단체ㆍ관계부처 협동조합 정책 지원ㆍ조정, 민관 네트워크 구축 등 협력체계에 관한 사항

rows.source_ko: 제8조(예산실) ① 예산실장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Budget Office) ① The Head of the Budget Office shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: ② 「기획예산처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제11조제1항에 따라 예산실장 밑에 두는 보좌기관은 예산총괄심의관ㆍ사회예산심의관ㆍ경제예산심의관ㆍ복지안전예산심의관 및 행정국방예산심의관으로 하며, 예산총괄심의관ㆍ사회예산심의관ㆍ경제예산심의관ㆍ복지안전예산심의관 및 행정국방예산심의관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 11 , Paragraph 1 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and its Affiliated Agencies,” the advisory bodies placed under the Director of the Budget Office shall be the Budget Planning and Review Officer, the Social Budget Planning Officer, the Economic Budget Planning Officer, the Welfare and Safety Budget Planning Officer, and the Administrative and National Defense Budget Planning Officer; the Budget Planning and Review Officer, the Social Budget Planning Officer, the Economic Budget Planning Officer, the Welfare and Safety Budget Planning Officer, and the Administrative and National Defense Budget Planning Officer shall be appointed as general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ③ 예산총괄심의관은「기획예산처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제11조제3항제1호부터 제25호까지의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director General of Budget Review assists the Director with matters under subparagraphs 1 through 25 of Article 11, Paragraph 3 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and Its Affiliated Agencies.”

rows.source_ko: ④ 사회예산심의관은 사회 분야의 중장기 추진방향, 예산편성ㆍ집행, 기금운용계획의 협의ㆍ조정, 성과관리 및 「기획예산처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제11조제3항제26호ㆍ제27호의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Social Budget Review Officer assists the Director in matters concerning mid-to-long-term promotion directions in the social sector, budget formulation and execution, consultation and coordination of fund management plans, performance management, and matters under Article 11 , Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 26 and 27 of the “Organization of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and its Affiliated Agencies.”

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 경제예산심의관은 경제 분야의 중장기 추진방향, 예산편성ㆍ집행, 기금운용계획의 협의ㆍ조정 및 성과관리 등의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Economic Budget Review Officer assists the Director in matters such as the mid-to-long-term direction of the economic sector, budget formulation and execution, consultation and coordination of fund management plans, and performance management.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 복지안전예산심의관은 보건복지 및 안전 분야의 중장기 추진방향, 예산편성ㆍ집행, 기금운용계획의 협의ㆍ조정, 성과관리 및 「기획예산처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제11조제3항제28호부터 제32호까지의 사항 등에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Director of Welfare and Safety Budget Review assists the Director in matters concerning mid-to-long-term promotion directions in the health, welfare, and safety sectors, budget formulation and execution, consultation and coordination of fund management plans, performance management, and matters under subparagraphs 28 through 32 of Article 11, Paragraph 3 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and Its Affiliated Agencies.”

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 행정국방예산심의관은 행정 및 국방 분야의 중장기 추진방향, 예산편성ㆍ집행, 기금운용계획의 협의ㆍ조정 및 성과관리 등의 사항에 관하여 실장을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Director of Administrative and Defense Budget Review assists the Director in matters such as mid-to-long-term directions for the administrative and defense sectors, budget formulation and execution, consultation and coordination of fund management plans, and performance management.

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 예산실에 예산총괄과ㆍ예산정책과ㆍ예산기준과ㆍ기금운용혁신과ㆍ예산소통협력과ㆍ고용노동예산과ㆍ기후에너지환경예산과ㆍ인적자원예산과ㆍ문화체육관광예산과ㆍ투자사업관리과ㆍ국토교통예산과ㆍ산업중소벤처예산과ㆍ인공지능디지털예산과ㆍ농림해양예산과ㆍ과학기술혁신예산과ㆍ국민복지예산과ㆍ연금보건예산과ㆍ지역예산과ㆍ국민안전예산과ㆍ법사예산과ㆍ행정외교예산과ㆍ국방예산과 및 방위력강화예산과를 두되, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Budget Office shall have the Budget Planning Division, Budget Policy Division, Budget Standards Division, Fund Management Innovation Division, Budget Communication and Cooperation Division, Employment and Labor Budget Division, Climate, Energy and Environment Budget Division, Human Resources Budget Division, Culture, Sports and Tourism Budget Division, Investment Project Management Division, Land, Infrastructure and Transport Budget Division, Industry, SMEs and Ventures Budget Division, Artificial Intelligence and Digital Budget Division, Agriculture, Forestry and Marine Budget Division, Science and Technology Innovation Budget Division, National Welfare Budget Division, Pension and Health Budget Division, Regional Budget Division, National Safety Budget Division, Legislation and Judiciary Budget Division, Administration and Diplomacy Budget Division, National Defense Budget Division, and Defense Capability Enhancement Budget Division, and each division head shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 예산총괄과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Head of the Budget Management Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 국가정책의 우선순위에 대한 목표 제시
rows.text_en: 1. Presentation of objectives regarding the priorities of national policies related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 국가정책의 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Planning and coordination of national policies involving budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 3. 중장기 재원배분에 관련되는 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 3. Overall management of tasks related to mid-to-long-term resource allocation

rows.source_ko: 4. 분야별ㆍ기관별 재원의 사전배분에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the advance allocation of financial resources by sector and institution

rows.source_ko: 5. 세입ㆍ세출예산의 편성과 관련되는 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management of tasks related to the formulation of revenue and expenditure budgets

rows.source_ko: 6. 국회에 제출하는 예산 심의와 관련된 자료의 작성 및 협의
rows.text_en: 6. Preparation and consultation of materials related to budget deliberation to be submitted to the National Assembly

rows.source_ko: 7. 예비비의 관리
rows.text_en: 7. Management of Reserve Funds

rows.source_ko: 8. 전시예산의 편성 및 그 집행ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 8. Formulation of the Exhibition Budget and Its Execution and Management

rows.source_ko: 9. 각 부처 기본경비 편성업무의 종합
rows.text_en: 9. Comprehensive review of basic expense planning for each ministry

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖에 국가재정운용계획, 예산편성 및 기금운용계획의 작성과 관련하여 실내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the office regarding the preparation of the National Financial Management Plan, budget formulation, and fund management plan

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 예산정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 10. The Head of the Budget Policy Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산안 편성지침의 작성ㆍ통보
rows.text_en: 1. Preparation and Notification of Budget Formulation Guidelines

rows.source_ko: 2. 국가재정운용계획상 부처별ㆍ분야별 재원배분에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the allocation of financial resources by ministry and sector under the National Financial Management Plan

rows.source_ko: 3. 재정수입의 추계ㆍ분석 및 중기 총수입 전망
rows.text_en: 3. Estimation and Analysis of Fiscal Revenue and Medium-term Gross Revenue Forecast

rows.source_ko: 4. 조세수입, 차관수입 및 세외수입에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning tax revenue, loan revenue, and non-tax revenue

rows.source_ko: 5. 재정수지의 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the management of the fiscal balance

rows.source_ko: 6. 재정지출을 수반하는 중장기 계획 협의ㆍ조정 총괄
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management of consultation and coordination of medium- and long-term plans involving fiscal expenditure

rows.source_ko: 7. 특별회계 신설의 타당성 심사관련 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 7. Overall management of tasks related to the feasibility review of establishing new special accounts

rows.source_ko: 8. 예산제도개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the improvement of the budget system

rows.source_ko: 9. 의무지출의 증가율과 산출명세 작성에 관한 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 9. Overall management of tasks regarding the growth rate of mandatory expenditures and the preparation of calculation details

rows.source_ko: 10. 재량지출의 분야별 증가율 전망과 근거에 관한 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 10. Overall management of work regarding the forecast and basis for the growth rates of discretionary spending by sector

rows.source_ko: 11. 예산 관련 경제사회지표 분석 및 국내외 예산제도 연구ㆍ조사
rows.text_en: 11. Analysis of Budget-Related Economic and Social Indicators and Research and Survey of Domestic and International Budget Systems

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 예산기준과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 11 The Head of the Budget Standards Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국가공무원 정원 증원에 따른 예산협의
rows.text_en: 1. Budget consultation regarding the increase in the number of national civil servants

rows.source_ko: 2. 인건비와 관련된 예산의 심사ㆍ협의
rows.text_en: 2. Review and consultation of the budget related to personnel costs

rows.source_ko: 3. 책임운영기관 예산의 편성 종합 및 책임운영기관 특별회계의 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Comprehensive Budgeting of Responsible Management Agencies and Operation of Special Accounts for Responsible Management Agencies

rows.source_ko: 4. 예산 및 기금운용의 효율화를 위한 집행관리지침의 작성ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 4. Preparation and management of execution management guidelines for the efficiency of budget and fund operations

rows.source_ko: 5. 예산편성 및 기금운용계획 수립에 필요한 기준 및 단가의 책정
rows.text_en: 5. Determination of standards and unit prices necessary for budget formulation and fund management plan formulation

rows.source_ko: 6. 각 부처의 공통경비 편성
rows.text_en: 6. Formulation of common expenses for each ministry

rows.source_ko: 7. 예산과목의 조정 및 기금의 항목구분ㆍ작성과 관련된 세부기준의 설정
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment of detailed standards related to the adjustment of budget items and the classification and preparation of fund items

rows.source_ko: 8. 예산과 기금간의 재정지원 원칙의 확립에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the establishment of principles for financial support between the budget and the fund

rows.source_ko: 9. 기준보조율, 민간보조금 등 「보조금 관리에 관한 법률」의 운용
rows.text_en: 9. Operation of the "Act on the Management of Subsidies," including standard subsidy rates and private subsidies

rows.source_ko: 10. 보조금 예산의 편성기준과 관련지침 작성에 관한 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 10. Overall management of tasks related to the preparation of subsidy budget formulation standards and related guidelines

rows.source_ko: 11. 공무원단체 관련 업무의 종합
rows.text_en: 11. Comprehensive review of affairs related to public official organizations

rows.source_ko: 12. 각 부처 협업 관련 예산의 조정ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 12. Coordination and overall management of budgets related to collaboration among ministries

rows.source_ko: 13. 인사혁신처 소관 일반회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 13. Management of Budget Formulation and Execution of the General Account under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of Personnel Management

rows.source_ko: ⑫ 기금운용혁신과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑫ The Head of Fund Management Innovation is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 기금운용계획안 및 기금운용계획 변경안의 협의ㆍ조정과 관련된 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of tasks related to the consultation and coordination of the draft fund management plan and the draft amendment to the fund management plan

rows.source_ko: 2. 국회에 제출하는 기금운용계획안의 심의와 관련된 자료의 작성 및 협의
rows.text_en: 2. Preparation of materials and consultation regarding the deliberation of the draft fund management plan submitted to the National Assembly

rows.source_ko: 3. 기금운용기본정책의 수립
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment of Basic Fund Management Policy

rows.source_ko: 4. 기금수입관련 정책의 수립에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the establishment of policies related to fund revenue

rows.source_ko: 5. 회계ㆍ기금간 여유재원의 통합적 활용에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the integrated utilization of surplus funds between accounts and funds

rows.source_ko: 6. 기금신설의 타당성 심사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the feasibility review of the establishment of a fund

rows.source_ko: 7. 기금운용관련 정보화계획의 수립 및 추진
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment and implementation of informatization plans related to fund management

rows.source_ko: 8. 전시기금운용계획의 수립 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment of Exhibition Fund Operation Plan and Management of Execution

rows.source_ko: 9. 각 기금의 기금관리비 협의ㆍ조정업무의 종합
rows.text_en: 9. Comprehensive management of consultation and adjustment of fund management expenses for each fund

rows.source_ko: 10. 기금관련 인건비에 대한 기준의 작성
rows.text_en: 10. Establishment of standards for fund-related personnel expenses

rows.source_ko: 11. 기금운용계획안 작성지침의 작성ㆍ통보
rows.text_en: 11. Preparation and Notification of Guidelines for the Draft Fund Management Plan

rows.source_ko: 12. 기금운용의 효율화를 위한 기금집행관리지침의 작성ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 12. Preparation and Management of Fund Execution Guidelines for the Efficiency of Fund Operation

rows.source_ko: 13. 복권기금, 재정경제부 소관 공공자금관리기금의 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 13. Consultation and coordination of the Lottery Fund and the Public Funds Management Fund under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Finance and Economy

rows.source_ko: 14. 중장기 기금관리계획의 협의ㆍ조정과 관련된 업무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 14. Overall management of tasks related to the consultation and coordination of mid-to-long-term fund management plans

rows.source_ko: 15. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 공적개발원조 분야 주요정책과제의 중장기 추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 15. Establishment of Mid-to-Long-Term Implementation Directions for Major Policy Tasks in the Official Development Assistance Sector Related to Budget and Funds

rows.source_ko: 16. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 공적개발원조 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 16. Forecast of Mid-to-Long-Term Fiscal Requirements and Planning and Coordination for Official Development Assistance Policies Related to Budgets and Funds

rows.source_ko: 17. 재정경제부ㆍ기획예산처ㆍ금융위원회ㆍ공정거래위원회ㆍ국세청ㆍ관세청 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 17. Management of budget formulation and execution of general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Finance and Economy, Ministry of Planning and Budget, Financial Services Commission, Fair Trade Commission, National Tax Service, and Korea Customs Service

rows.source_ko: 18. 재정경제부ㆍ기획예산처ㆍ금융위원회 소관 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정과 기금운용계획의 변경협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 18. Consultation and coordination of draft fund management plans under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Finance and Economy, the Ministry of Planning and Budget, and the Financial Services Commission; consultation on changes to fund management plans; and management of execution

rows.source_ko: 19. 공공기관 인건비 편성 관련 사항
rows.text_en: 19. Matters concerning the budgeting of personnel expenses for public institutions

rows.source_ko: 20. 조달청 소관 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 20. Management of Budget Formulation and Execution of Special Accounts under the Jurisdiction of the Public Procurement Service

rows.source_ko: ⑬ 예산소통협력과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 13. The Head of the Budget Communication and Cooperation Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 국고보조금의 집행 실적관리 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of government subsidy execution performance

rows.source_ko: 2. 국제기구 등과의 예산과 관련된 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Budget-related work with international organizations, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 예산 배정과 관련되는 제도 등 업무 총괄
rows.text_en: 3. Overall management of tasks, including systems related to budget allocation

rows.source_ko: 4. 예산과 관련된 국제기구와의 공동연구에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning joint research with international organizations regarding the budget

rows.source_ko: 5. 재정정책자문회의 운영
rows.text_en: 5. Operation of the Fiscal Policy Advisory Council

rows.source_ko: 6. 예산ㆍ기금 및 관련 주요 정책에 관한 이해관계자 및 대국민 의견수렴ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 6. Collection and analysis of opinions from stakeholders and the public regarding budgets, funds, and related major policies

rows.source_ko: 7. 예산ㆍ기금 및 관련 주요 정책에 관한 홍보
rows.text_en: 7. Promotion of budgets, funds, and related major policies

rows.source_ko: 8. 공무원단체 관련 예산에 관한 대외 협의 업무
rows.text_en: 8. External consultation duties regarding the budget of public official organizations

rows.source_ko: 9. 국내외 행사비 예산의 심의ㆍ편성
rows.text_en: 9. Deliberation and Formulation of Budget for Domestic and International Events

rows.text_en: 14. The Head of the Employment and Labor Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 고용 분야 주요 정책과제의 중장기 추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major employment policy tasks related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 2. 일자리 창출 지원에 관한 정부정책의 종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Comprehensive coordination of government policies regarding support for job creation

rows.source_ko: 3. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 고용 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Forecast of Mid-to-Long-Term Fiscal Requirements and Planning and Coordination for Employment Policies Related to Budgets and Funds

rows.source_ko: 4. 고용노동부ㆍ국가데이터처 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of budget formulation and execution of general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and the National Data Office

rows.source_ko: 5. 고용노동부 소관 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정, 기금운용계획의 변경협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation and coordination of draft fund management plans under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Employment and Labor, consultation on changes to fund management plans, and management of execution

rows.source_ko: 6. 재정 지원을 통한 일자리 사업 예산편성
rows.text_en: 6. Budgeting for Job Creation Projects through Financial Support

rows.source_ko: 7. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 고용 분야의 사업 및 일자리 사업에 대한 성과관리
rows.text_en: 7. Performance management of employment projects and job creation programs involving budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: ⑮ 기후에너지환경예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 15. The Head of the Climate, Energy, Environment, and Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 환경 분야 주요 정책과제의 중장기 추진 방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major environmental policy tasks related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 2. 기후위기 대응 및 탄소중립 분야 예산의 종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Consolidation and Coordination of the Budget for Climate Crisis Response and Carbon Neutrality

rows.source_ko: 3. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 환경 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Forecast of Mid-to-Long-Term Fiscal Requirements and Planning and Coordination for Environmental Policies Related to Budgets and Funds

rows.source_ko: 4. 기후에너지환경부ㆍ기상청 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of budget formulation and execution of general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Korea Meteorological Administration

rows.source_ko: 5. 기후에너지환경부 소관 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정과 기금운용계획의 변경협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation and coordination of draft fund management plans under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment, consultation on changes to fund management plans, and management of execution

rows.source_ko: 6. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 환경 분야의 사업에 대한 성과관리
rows.text_en: 6. Performance management for environmental projects involving budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 7. 기후대응기금 관련 협의ㆍ조정과 온실가스감축인지예산제도의 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Consultation and Coordination Regarding the Climate Response Fund and Operation of the Greenhouse Gas Reduction Aware Budget System

rows.source_ko: 8. 에너지 및 자원사업특별회계 예산의 편성ㆍ종합
rows.text_en: 8. Formulation and Comprehensive Review of the Special Account for Energy and Resource Business Budget

rows.source_ko: ⑯ 인적자원예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 16. The Head of the Human Resources Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 교육ㆍ보훈 분야 주요 정책과제의 중장기추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major policy tasks in the education and veterans affairs sectors related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 교육ㆍ보훈 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Projection of Mid-to-Long-Term Financial Requirements and Planning and Coordination for Policies in the Education and Veterans Affairs Sectors Related to Budgets and Funds

rows.source_ko: 3. 교육부ㆍ국가보훈부 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of budget formulation and execution of general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs

rows.source_ko: 4. 지방교육재정교부금 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of Budgeting and Execution of Local Education Finance Grants

rows.source_ko: 5. 교육부 및 국가보훈부 소관 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정, 기금운용계획의 변경협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation and coordination of draft fund management plans under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, consultation on changes to fund management plans, and management of execution

rows.source_ko: 6. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 교육ㆍ보훈 분야의 사업에 대한 성과관리
rows.text_en: 6. Performance management for projects in the education and veterans affairs sectors involving budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: ⑰ 문화체육관광예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 17 The Head of the Culture, Sports and Tourism Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 문화ㆍ관광ㆍ체육 및 방송미디어통신위원회 소관 방송통신 분야 주요 정책과제의 중장기 추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major policy tasks related to budgets and funds in the fields of Culture, Tourism, Sports, and Broadcasting and Telecommunications under the jurisdiction of the Korea Communications Commission

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 문화ㆍ관광ㆍ체육 및 방송미디어통신위원회 소관 방송통신 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Forecast of mid-to-long-term financial requirements and planning and coordination regarding policies in the Culture, Tourism, Sports, and Broadcasting and Telecommunications sectors under the jurisdiction of the Broadcasting, Media and Communications Commission related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 3. 문화체육관광부ㆍ국가유산청 및 방송미디어통신위원회 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of budget formulation and execution of general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the National Heritage Administration, and the Korea Communications Commission

rows.source_ko: 4. 문화체육관광부ㆍ국가유산청 및 방송미디어통신위원회 소관 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정, 기금운용계획의 변경협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation and coordination of draft fund management plans under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the National Heritage Administration, and the Korea Communications Commission; consultation on changes to fund management plans; and management of execution

rows.source_ko: 5. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 문화ㆍ관광ㆍ체육 및 방송미디어통신위원회 소관 방송통신 분야 사업에 대한 성과관리
rows.text_en: 5. Performance management for projects in the fields of Culture, Tourism, Sports, and Broadcasting and Telecommunications under the jurisdiction of the Korea Communications Commission that involve budgets or funds

rows.source_ko: ⑱ 투자사업관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 18. The Head of the Investment Project Management Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 총사업비관리제도에 대한 정책의 수립ㆍ총괄
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and overall management of policies regarding the total project cost management system

rows.source_ko: 2. 총사업비관리지침 및 부문별 총사업비 조정기준의 수립
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of Total Project Cost Management Guidelines and Sectoral Total Project Cost Adjustment Criteria

rows.source_ko: 3. 총사업비 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 3. Consultation and Adjustment of Total Project Cost

rows.source_ko: 4. 대규모 공공투자관리시스템의 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and Operation of a Large-Scale Public Investment Management System

rows.source_ko: 5. 중앙관서 자율조정제도의 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Operation and Management of the Central Government Autonomous Coordination System

rows.source_ko: ⑲ 국토교통예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 19. The Head of the Land, Infrastructure and Transport Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 수송ㆍ교통 및 지역개발 분야 주요 정책과제의 중장기 추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major policy tasks in the transportation and traffic and regional development sectors related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 수송ㆍ교통 및 지역개발 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Forecasting of Mid-to-Long-Term Fiscal Requirements and Planning and Coordination for Policies in the Transportation, Traffic, and Regional Development Sectors Related to Budgets and Funds

rows.source_ko: 3. 국토교통부ㆍ행정중심복합도시건설청 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of budget formulation and execution of general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the Sejong City Construction Agency

rows.source_ko: 4. 교통시설특별회계 예산의 편성ㆍ종합
rows.text_en: 4. Formulation and Comprehensive Management of the Special Account for Transportation Facilities Budget

rows.source_ko: 5. 국토교통부 소관 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정, 변경협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation and coordination, consultation on amendments, and management of execution of draft fund management plans under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport

rows.source_ko: 6. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 수송ㆍ교통 및 지역개발 분야의 사업에 대한 성과관리
rows.text_en: 6. Performance management for projects in the transportation, traffic, and regional development sectors involving budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: ⑳ 산업중소벤처예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 20 The Head of the Industry, SMEs, and Venture Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 산업ㆍ중소기업 및 에너지 분야 주요 정책과제의 중장기추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major policy tasks in the industry, SME, and energy sectors related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 산업ㆍ중소기업 및 에너지 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Forecasting of mid-to-long-term fiscal requirements and planning and coordination for policies in the industrial, SME, and energy sectors related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 3. 산업통상부ㆍ중소벤처기업부ㆍ지식재산처 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of budget formulation and execution of general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, the Ministry of SMEs and Startups, and the Intellectual Property Office

rows.source_ko: 4. 산업통상부ㆍ중소벤처기업부 소관 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정, 변경협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation, coordination, amendment consultation, and management of execution of draft fund management plans under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and the Ministry of SMEs and Startups

rows.source_ko: 5. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 산업ㆍ중소기업 및 에너지 분야 사업에 대한 성과관리
rows.text_en: 5. Performance management for projects in the industrial, SME, and energy sectors involving budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: ㉑ 인공지능디지털예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 21 The Head of the Artificial Intelligence and Digital Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 정보통신 분야 및 과학기술정보통신부 소관 방송통신 분야 관련 주요 정책과제의 중장기추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major policy tasks related to the information and communications sector concerning budgets and funds, and the broadcasting and telecommunications sector under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Science and ICT

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 정보통신 분야 및 과학기술정보통신부 소관 방송통신 분야 관련 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Forecasting of mid-to-long-term fiscal requirements and planning and coordination regarding policies related to the information and communications sector concerning budgets and funds, and the broadcasting and telecommunications sector under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Science and ICT

rows.source_ko: 3. 과학기술정보통신부 소관 정보통신 및 방송통신 분야의 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of budget formulation and execution of general and special accounts in the information and communications and broadcasting and communications sectors under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Science and ICT

rows.source_ko: 4. 과학기술정보통신부 소관 정보통신 및 방송통신 분야 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정과 기금운용계획의 변경협의 및 집행의 관리

Consultation and coordination of draft fund management plans for the information and communications and broadcasting and telecommunications sectors under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Science and ICT, as well as consultation on changes to fund management plans and management of execution

rows.source_ko: 5. 각 부처의 정보통신 분야 관련 사업에 대한 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Management of budget formulation and execution for information and communications-related projects of each ministry

rows.source_ko: 6. 정보통신 분야 관련 예산의 종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Consolidation and coordination of budgets related to the information and communications sector

rows.source_ko: 7. 각 기금의 정보통신 분야 관련 사업에 대한 기금운용계획안 협의ㆍ조정과 기금운용계획의 변경협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 7. Consultation and coordination of fund management plans for projects related to the information and communications sector of each fund, consultation on changes to fund management plans, and management of execution

rows.source_ko: 8. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 정보통신 분야 및 과학기술정보통신부 소관 방송통신 분야 관련 사업에 대한 성과관리
rows.text_en: 8. Performance management for projects in the information and communications sector involving budgets and funds, and projects in the broadcasting and telecommunications sector under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Science and ICT

rows.source_ko: ㉒ 농림해양예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 22 The Head of the Agriculture, Forestry, and Fisheries Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 농업ㆍ임업ㆍ수산업 및 해양 분야 주요 정책과제의 중장기 추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major policy tasks in the agriculture, forestry, fisheries, and marine sectors related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 농업ㆍ임업ㆍ수산업 및 해양 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Forecasting of mid-to-long-term fiscal requirements and planning and coordination for policies in the agriculture, forestry, fisheries, and marine sectors related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 3. 농림축산식품부ㆍ해양수산부ㆍ농촌진흥청ㆍ산림청 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of budget formulation and execution of general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, the Rural Development Administration, and the Korea Forest Service

rows.source_ko: 4. 농어촌구조개선특별회계 및 농어촌특별세관리특별회계 예산의 편성ㆍ종합
rows.text_en: 4. Formulation and Comprehensive Management of the Budget for the Special Account for Rural Structure Improvement and the Special Account for Rural Special Tax Management

rows.source_ko: 5. 농림축산식품부ㆍ해양수산부 소관 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정, 변경협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation, coordination, amendment consultation, and management of execution of draft fund management plans under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries

rows.source_ko: 6. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 농업ㆍ임업ㆍ수산업 및 해양 분야의 사업에 대한 성과관리
rows.text_en: 6. Performance management for projects in the agriculture, forestry, fisheries, and marine sectors involving budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: ㉓ 과학기술혁신예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 23 The Head of the Science and Technology Innovation Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 연구개발 분야 주요 정책과제의 중장기 추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major policy tasks in the R&D sector related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 연구개발 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Forecast of Mid-to-Long-Term Financial Requirements and Planning and Coordination for R&D Policies Related to Budgets and Funds

rows.source_ko: 3. 과학기술정보통신부(정보통신 분야 및 방송통신 분야를 제외한다)ㆍ우주항공청ㆍ원자력안전위원회 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of budget formulation and execution for general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Science and ICT (excluding the information and communications and broadcasting and telecommunications sectors), the Aerospace Administration, and the Nuclear Safety and Security Commission

rows.source_ko: 4. 과학기술정보통신부(정보통신 분야 및 방송통신 분야를 제외한다) 소관 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정ㆍ변경관리 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation, coordination, management of changes to, and management of execution of draft fund management plans under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Science and ICT (excluding the information and communications and broadcasting and telecommunications sectors)

rows.source_ko: 5. 각 부처의 연구개발사업에 대한 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Management of budget formulation and execution for research and development projects of each ministry

rows.source_ko: 6. 연구개발 관련 예산의 종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Consolidation and Coordination of Research and Development Budgets

rows.source_ko: 7. 각 기금의 연구개발사업에 대한 기금운용계획안 협의ㆍ조정, 변경 협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 7. Consultation and coordination of fund operation plans, consultation on changes, and management of execution for research and development projects of each fund

rows.source_ko: 8. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 연구개발사업에 대한 성과관리
rows.text_en: 8. Performance Management for Research and Development Projects Involving Budgets and Funds

rows.source_ko: 9. 정부출연연구기관 예산의 편성ㆍ종합 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 9. Management of Budget Formulation, Consolidation, and Execution of Government-Funded Research Institutes

rows.source_ko: ㉔ 국민복지예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 24 The Head of the National Welfare Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 사회복지 분야 주요 정책과제의 중장기 추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major policy tasks in the social welfare sector related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 사회복지 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Projection of Mid-to-Long-Term Financial Requirements and Planning and Coordination for Social Welfare Policies Related to Budgets and Funds

rows.source_ko: 3. 보건복지부 소관 중 사회복지 분야 및 성평등가족부 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of budget formulation and execution for the social welfare sector under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Health and Welfare and the general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family

rows.source_ko: 4. 보건복지부 소관 중 사회복지 분야 및 성평등가족부 소관 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정과 기금운용계획의 변경협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation and coordination of draft fund management plans for the social welfare sector under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Health and Welfare and the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family, as well as consultation on changes to fund management plans and management of execution

rows.source_ko: 5. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 사회복지 분야 및 성평등가족부 소관 사업에 대한 성과관리
rows.text_en: 5. Performance management for social welfare sectors involving budgets and funds, and projects under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family

rows.source_ko: ㉕ 연금보건예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 25. The Head of the Pension and Health Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 연금 및 보건 분야 주요 정책과제의 중장기 추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major policy tasks in the pension and health sectors related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 연금 및 보건 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Forecasting of Mid-to-Long-Term Fiscal Requirements and Planning and Coordination for Pension and Health Policies Related to Budgets and Funds

rows.source_ko: 3. 연금, 보건복지부 소관 중 보건 분야 및 식품의약품안전처 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of budget formulation and execution for pensions, the health sector under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Health and Welfare, and the general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety

rows.source_ko: 4. 연금, 보건복지부 소관 중 보건 분야 및 식품의약품안전처 소관 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정과 기금운용계획의 변경협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation and coordination of draft fund management plans for pensions, the health sector under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Health and Welfare, and the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety; consultation on changes to fund management plans; and management of execution.

rows.source_ko: 5. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 연금, 보건복지부 소관 중 보건 분야 및 식품의약품안전처 관련 사업에 대한 성과관리
rows.text_en: 5. Performance management for pensions involving budgets and funds, health sectors under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Health and Welfare, and projects related to the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety

rows.source_ko: ㉖ 지역예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ㉖ The Regional Budget Division Manager is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 지역발전계획 및 기초생활권발전계획과 관련된 재정투자계획 및 연도별 투자계획의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of financial investment plans and annual investment plans related to regional development plans and basic living area development plans

rows.source_ko: 2. 지역균형발전특별회계 예산안 편성지침의 작성ㆍ통보
rows.text_en: 2. Preparation and Notification of Budget Formulation Guidelines for the Special Account for Balanced Regional Development

rows.source_ko: 3. 지역균형발전특별회계 대상사업의 선정 및 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Selection and Management of Projects Subject to the Special Account for Balanced Regional Development

rows.source_ko: 4. 지역균형발전특별회계 세입ㆍ세출예산의 종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 4. Consolidation and Coordination of Revenue and Expenditure Budgets of the Special Account for Balanced Regional Development

rows.source_ko: 5. 지역균형발전특별회계 예산집행 및 성과관리의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management and coordination of budget execution and performance management of the Special Account for Balanced Regional Development

rows.source_ko: 6. 지역개발사업과 관련된 재정투자계획의 종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Comprehensive coordination of financial investment plans related to regional development projects

rows.source_ko: 7. 지역균형발전특별회계의 관리 및 결산
rows.text_en: 7. Management and Settlement of the Special Account for Balanced Regional Development

rows.source_ko: 8. 「지방자치분권 및 지역균형발전에 관한 특별법」 (지역균형발전특별회계에 관한 사항만 해당한다)의 운영 및 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Operation and management of the "Special Act on Local Autonomy and Decentralization and Balanced Regional Development" (only applicable to matters concerning the Special Account for Balanced Regional Development).

rows.source_ko: 9. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 지역발전 관련 시책의 종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 9. Comprehensive coordination of regional development policies involving budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 10. 지방시대 종합계획 및 기초생활권 발전계획 등과 관련된 중장기 재정재원계획의 수립ㆍ분석
rows.text_en: 10. Establishment and analysis of mid-to-long-term fiscal resource plans related to the Comprehensive Plan for the Local Era and Basic Living Area Development Plans, etc.

rows.source_ko: 11. 지역발전투자협약제도 및 체결과 관련된 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters related to the Regional Development Investment Agreement system and its conclusion

rows.source_ko: 12. 제주특별자치도 관련 예산의 편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 12. Management of Budget Formulation and Execution Related to Jeju Special Self-Governing Province

rows.source_ko: 13. 혁신도시건설특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 13. Management of Budget Formulation and Execution of the Special Account for Innovation City Construction

rows.source_ko: 14. 그 밖에 지역발전과 관련한 주요 예산의 종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 14. Other comprehensive coordination of major budgets related to regional development

rows.source_ko: ㉗ 국민안전예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ㉗ The Head of the National Safety Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 재난ㆍ안전 분야 주요 정책과제의 중장기 추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major policy tasks in the disaster and safety sector related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 재난ㆍ안전 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Forecasting of Mid-to-Long-Term Fiscal Requirements and Planning and Coordination for Disaster and Safety Policies Related to Budgets and Funds

rows.source_ko: 3. 행정안전부(재난ㆍ안전 분야를 말한다)ㆍ소방청ㆍ해양경찰청 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of budget formulation and execution of general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety (referring to the disaster and safety sector), the National Fire Agency, and the Korea Coast Guard

rows.source_ko: 4. 행정안전부(재난ㆍ안전 분야를 말한다)ㆍ소방청ㆍ해양경찰청 소관 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정과 기금운용계획의 변경협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation and coordination of draft fund management plans under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety (referring to the disaster and safety sector), the National Fire Agency, and the Korea Coast Guard, as well as consultation on changes to fund management plans and management of execution

rows.source_ko: 5. 각 부처의 재난ㆍ안전 분야 관련 예산의 종합ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Consolidation and coordination of disaster and safety-related budgets across ministries

rows.source_ko: 6. 각 부처의 재난ㆍ안전 분야 관련 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Management of budget formulation and execution related to disaster and safety in each ministry

rows.source_ko: 7. 재해대책 관련 지원기준의 설정
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment of support standards related to disaster countermeasures

rows.source_ko: 8. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 재난ㆍ안전 분야의 사업에 대한 성과관리
rows.text_en: 8. Performance management for projects in the disaster and safety sector involving budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: ㉘ 법사예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 28 The Head of the Legislative and Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 법사ㆍ치안 분야 주요 정책과제의 중장기 추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major policy tasks in the legal and public security sectors related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 법사ㆍ치안 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Forecast of Mid-to-Long-Term Financial Requirements and Planning and Coordination for Policies in the Legal Affairs and Public Security Sectors Related to Budgets and Funds

rows.source_ko: 3. 국회ㆍ대법원ㆍ헌법재판소ㆍ중앙선거관리위원회ㆍ감사원ㆍ국무조정실ㆍ국무총리비서실ㆍ법무부ㆍ법제처ㆍ경찰청ㆍ국가인권위원회 ㆍ국민권익위원회 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of budget formulation and execution of general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the National Assembly, the Supreme Court, the Constitutional Court, the National Election Commission, the Board of Audit and Inspection, the Office for Government Policy Coordination, the Prime Minister's Secretariat, the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Government Legislation, the National Police Agency, the National Human Rights Commission of Korea, and the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission

rows.source_ko: 4. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 법사ㆍ치안 분야의 사업에 대한 성과관리
rows.text_en: 4. Performance management for projects in the legal and public security sectors involving budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 5. 재정경제부 소관 국유재산관리기금 관련 협의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Consultation and coordination regarding the State Property Management Fund under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Finance and Economy

rows.source_ko: ㉙ 행정외교예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ㉙ The Head of the Administrative, Diplomatic, and Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 통일ㆍ외교 및 행정 분야 주요 정책과제의 중장기 추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major policy tasks in the fields of unification, foreign affairs, and administration related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 통일ㆍ외교 및 행정 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Forecasting of Mid-to-Long-Term Fiscal Requirements and Planning and Coordination for Policies in the Fields of Unification, Diplomacy, and Administration Related to Budgets and Funds

rows.source_ko: 3. 대통령비서실ㆍ국가안보실ㆍ대통령경호처ㆍ민주평화통일자문회의ㆍ외교부ㆍ통일부ㆍ행정안전부(재난ㆍ안전 분야는 제외한다) 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of budget formulation and execution of general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the Presidential Secretariat, the National Security Office, the Presidential Security Service, the National Advisory Council on Democratic Peaceful Unification, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Unification, and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety (excluding disaster and safety sectors)

rows.source_ko: 4. 국가와 지방자치단체 간 재원배분에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the allocation of financial resources between the State and local governments

rows.source_ko: 5. 국가와 지방자치단체 간 재정제도에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the fiscal system between the State and local governments

rows.source_ko: 6. 지방재정교부금 예산의 편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Management of Budget Formulation and Execution of Local Government Financial Grants

rows.source_ko: 7. 행정안전부(재난ㆍ안전 분야를 제외한다)ㆍ외교부ㆍ통일부 소관 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정과 기금운용계획의 변경협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 7. Consultation and coordination of draft fund management plans under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety (excluding disaster and safety sectors), the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the Ministry of Unification; consultation on changes to fund management plans; and management of execution

rows.source_ko: 8. 예산ㆍ기금이 수반되는 통일ㆍ외교 및 행정 분야의 사업에 대한 성과관리
rows.text_en: 8. Performance management of projects in the fields of unification, diplomacy, and administration involving budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 9. 공적개발원조 예산 편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 9. Management of Official Development Assistance Budgeting and Execution

rows.source_ko: ㉚ 국방예산과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: 30 The Head of the Defense Budget Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 국방 분야 주요 정책과제의 중장기 추진방향 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term implementation directions for major defense policy tasks related to budgets and funds

rows.source_ko: 2. 예산ㆍ기금과 관련된 국방 분야 시책에 대한 중장기 재정소요 전망 및 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Forecasting of Mid-to-Long-Term Financial Requirements and Planning and Coordination for Defense Policies Related to Budgets and Funds

rows.source_ko: 3. 국가정보원ㆍ국방부ㆍ병무청 소관 일반회계와 특별회계 예산편성 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 3. Management of budget formulation and execution of general and special accounts under the jurisdiction of the National Intelligence Service, the Ministry of National Defense, and the Military Manpower Administration

rows.source_ko: 4. 국방부 소관 기금운용계획안의 협의ㆍ조정과 기금운용계획의 변경협의 및 집행의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Consultation and coordination of draft fund management plans under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of National Defense, consultation on changes to fund management plans, and management of execution

rows.source_ko: 제3장 복권위원회 사무처
rows.text_en: Chapter 3 Lottery Commission Secretariat

rows.source_ko: 제10조(복권위원회사무처) ① 사무처장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Secretariat of the Lottery Commission) ① The Director of the Secretariat shall be appointed as a general civil servant belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 사무처에 복권총괄과ㆍ발행관리과 및 기금사업과를 두되, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관 또는 서기관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Secretariat shall establish the Lottery General Affairs Division, the Issuance Management Division, and the Fund Business Division, and the heads of each division shall be appointed as Deputy Directors, Science and Technology Secretary, or Secretary.

rows.source_ko: ③ 복권총괄과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Lottery Management Division shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 복권기금의 운용ㆍ관리와 관련된 기본정책에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning basic policies related to the operation and management of the lottery fund

rows.source_ko: 2. 복권기금의 운용전략의 수립 등 중장기 복권정책의 수립
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of mid-to-long-term lottery policies, including the formulation of lottery fund management strategies

rows.source_ko: 3. 복권과 관련된 정보와 복권기금운용실태의 공개
rows.text_en: 3. Disclosure of lottery-related information and the status of lottery fund management

rows.source_ko: 4. 건전한 복권문화 조성을 위한 교육 및 홍보
rows.text_en: 4. Education and promotion to foster a sound lottery culture

rows.source_ko: 5. 복권과 관련된 소송 및 분쟁사무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management of litigation and dispute matters related to the lottery

rows.source_ko: 6. 복권위원회 주요업무계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment of the Lottery Commission's Major Business Plan

rows.source_ko: 7. 복권위원회의 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Operation of the Lottery Commission

rows.source_ko: 8. 복권위원회의 공보 및 국회업무에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the Lottery Commission's public relations and parliamentary affairs

rows.source_ko: 9. 관서운영경비와 물품의 관리, 소속직원의 인사ㆍ복무 관리, 보안ㆍ관인ㆍ문서의 관리
rows.text_en: 9. Management of office operating expenses and supplies, personnel and service management of affiliated staff, and management of security, official seals, and documents

rows.source_ko: 10. 전산정보자료실 및 복권위원회 홈페이지의 운영
rows.text_en: 10. Operation of the Computerized Information Archives and the Lottery Commission Website

rows.source_ko: 11. 복권법령의 제ㆍ개정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the enactment and amendment of lottery laws and regulations

rows.source_ko: 12. 질의ㆍ회신 등 민원사항의 총괄
rows.text_en: 12. Overall management of civil complaints, including inquiries and responses

rows.source_ko: 13. 복권기금운용관리규정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning the Regulations on the Operation and Management of the Lottery Fund

rows.source_ko: 14. 복권판매 수입금의 징수 및 회계처리
rows.text_en: 14. Collection and Accounting of Lottery Sales Revenue

rows.source_ko: 15. 복권기금 결산보고서의 작성ㆍ제출 및 보고

rows.source_ko: 18. 그 밖에 사무처 내 다른 과의 소관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 18. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the Secretariat

rows.source_ko: ④ 발행관리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Issuance Management Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 복권의 종류ㆍ액면가액ㆍ총 발행금액 및 발행조건 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the type, face value, total issuance amount, and issuance conditions, etc. of the lottery ticket

rows.source_ko: 2. 복권발행업무의 위탁 및 재위탁에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the entrustment and re-entrustment of lottery issuance business

rows.source_ko: 3. 복권의 등위별 당첨금 및 당첨금의 비율 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning lottery prize money by rank and prize money ratios, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 연간복권발행계획서의 심의ㆍ조정 및 변경
rows.text_en: 4. Deliberation, Adjustment, and Modification of the Annual Lottery Issuance Plan

rows.source_ko: 5. 위탁ㆍ재위탁수수료, 판매수수료 등 복권유통비용의 책정
rows.text_en: 5. Determination of lottery distribution costs, such as consignment and sub-consignment fees and sales commissions

rows.source_ko: 6. 복권기금 수입계획의 작성 및 관리
rows.text_en: 6. Preparation and Management of Lottery Fund Revenue Plans

rows.source_ko: 7. 온라인복권 판매계약대상자의 요건ㆍ기준 등의 승인
rows.text_en: 7. Approval of requirements, standards, etc. for online lottery sales contract recipients

rows.source_ko: 8. 복권의 최종구매자와 청소년의 보호 및 사행성 억제를 위하여 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters necessary for the protection of final lottery purchasers and youth, and for the suppression of gambling.

rows.source_ko: 9. 복권의 발행ㆍ관리 및 판매지침에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning guidelines for the issuance, management, and sale of lotteries

rows.source_ko: 10. 복권 관계법령의 위반행위에 대한 지도ㆍ점검 및 과태료에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning guidance, inspection, and administrative fines for violations of lottery-related laws and regulations

rows.source_ko: 11. 복권상품의 기획ㆍ개발 및 기술의 개발ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 11. Planning and development of lottery products and development and management of technology

rows.source_ko: 12. 수탁사업자ㆍ재수탁사업자 등에 대한 관리ㆍ감독
rows.text_en: 12. Management and Supervision of Entrusted Business Operators, Sub-entrusted Business Operators, etc.

rows.source_ko: 13. 복권판매ㆍ수익 등 통계자료의 정리
rows.text_en: 13. Organization of statistical data such as lottery sales and revenue

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 기금사업과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of Fund Projects is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 복권수익금의 배분 및 사용
rows.text_en: 1. Distribution and Use of Lottery Proceeds

rows.source_ko: 2. 복권수익금사용계획서의 심의ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Deliberation and Adjustment of the Plan for the Use of Lottery Proceeds

rows.source_ko: 3. 복권기금운용계획의 수립ㆍ변경
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment and Amendment of Lottery Fund Management Plan

rows.source_ko: 4. 복권기금 중기재정운용계획의 수립ㆍ변경
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and Amendment of the Lottery Fund's Medium-term Financial Management Plan

rows.source_ko: 5. 복권기금운용계획의 집행 및 관리
rows.text_en: 5. Execution and Management of the Lottery Fund Operation Plan

rows.source_ko: 6. 복권기금 사업집행계획의 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 6. Establishment and Implementation of Lottery Fund Business Execution Plan

rows.text_en: 7. Receipt and review of applications for the use of project funds from the Lottery Fund

rows.source_ko: 9. 복권기금의 사용실태 점검
rows.text_en: 9. Inspection of Lottery Fund Usage

rows.text_en: Chapter 4. Number of Public Officials

rows.source_ko: 제11조(기획예산처에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 기획예산처에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원(「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제25조제1항에 따른 한시정원은 제외한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)은 별표 1과 같다. 다만, 「기획예산처와 그 소속기관 직제」 제17조제1항 단서에 따라 별표 1에 따른 총정원의 10퍼센트를 넘지 않는 범위에서 따로 정하는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: ① The personnel quotas for public officials in the Ministry of Planning and Budget by rank (excluding temporary quotas pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Personnel Quotas of Administrative Agencies”; hereinafter the same shall apply in this Article) shall be as set forth in Table 1. However, pursuant to the proviso to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the “Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Planning and Budget and Its Affiliated Agencies,” provided that such quotas do not exceed 10 percent of the total personnel quota set forth in Table 1, shall be as set forth in Table 2.

rows.source_ko: ② 기획예산처에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 64명(3급 또는 4급 4명, 4급 10명, 4급 또는 5급 4명, 5급 25명, 6급 11명, 7급 10명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Among the authorized number of public officials in the Ministry of Planning and Budget, 64 (4 in Grade 3 or 4, 10 in Grade 4, 4 in Grade 4 or 5, 25 in Grade 5, 11 in Grade 6, and 10 in Grade 7) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials.

rows.source_ko: ③ 기획예산처에 두는 공무원 정원 중 연기금 관련 업무를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명) 및 디지털 홍보 업무를 담당하는 1명(5급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Among the civil servant positions in the Ministry of Planning and Budget, one person (Grade 5) in charge of pension fund-related duties and one person (Grade 5) in charge of digital public relations duties shall be appointed as a fixed-term civil servant.

rows.source_ko: 제12조(소속기관에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 기획예산처의 소속기관에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 3과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Standard Quota of Public Officials in Affiliated Agencies) ① The standard quota of public officials by rank in the agencies affiliated with the Ministry of Planning and Budget is as set forth in Attached Table 3 .

rows.source_ko: ② 기획예산처의 소속기관에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원 중 2명(4급 또는 5급 1명, 5급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Two of the authorized number of public officials by rank in agencies affiliated with the Ministry of Planning and Budget (one person of Grade 4 or 5, and one person of Grade 5) may be appointed as fixed-term public officials.

rows.source_ko: Article 13 (Operation of Quotas for Part-time Public Officials) Pursuant to Article 24 , Paragraph 3 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Quotas of Administrative Agencies” and Article 3-3, Paragraph 1 of the “Public Officials Appointment Decree,” the quota for part-time public officials to be employed by the Ministry of Planning and Budget and its affiliated agencies may be operated by utilizing a portion of the quota for public officials to be employed by the Ministry of Planning and Budget and its affiliated agencies.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Operation of Quotas for Part-time Public Officials) Pursuant to Article 24 , Paragraph 3 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Quotas of Administrative Agencies” and Article 3-3, Paragraph 1 of the “Public Officials Appointment Decree,” the quota for part-time public officials to be employed by the Ministry of Planning and Budget and its affiliated agencies may be operated by utilizing a portion of the quota for public officials to be employed by the Ministry of Planning and Budget and its affiliated agencies.

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on January 2, 2026.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on January 2, 2026.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Duration of Job Grades Upgraded to Total Personnel Cost System)  ① Among the personnel quotas whose job grades were upgraded due to the enforcement of the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies, Decree No. 922 of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance (including the contents amended pursuant to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies, Decree No. 1014 of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies, Decree No. 1067 of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies, and Decree No. 1142 of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies), the quota of 6 positions (6 Administrative Officers) specified in Annex 2 shall remain in effect until March 31, 2027, and thereafter, the corresponding quota shall be deemed to be the quota of 6 positions (6 Administrative Junior Officers) specified in Annex 2.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Duration of Job Grades Upgraded to Total Personnel Cost System)  ① Among the personnel quotas whose job grades were upgraded due to the enforcement of the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies, Decree No. 922 of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance (including the contents amended pursuant to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies, Decree No. 1014 of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies, Decree No. 1067 of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies, and Decree No. 1142 of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and Its Affiliated Agencies), the quota of 6 positions (6 Administrative Officers) specified in Annex 2 shall remain in effect until March 31, 2027, and thereafter, the corresponding quota shall be deemed to be the quota of 6 positions (6 Administrative Junior Officers) specified in Annex 2.

rows.source_ko: ② Among the personnel quotas whose ranks have been adjusted upwards due to the enforcement of the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and its Affiliated Agencies (Ministry of Strategy and Finance Decree No. 1067, including the contents amended pursuant to the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules on the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Strategy and Finance and its Affiliated Agencies, Ministry of Strategy and Finance Decree No. 1142), the quota of 4 positions (2 Senior Officials or Administrative Officers, 2 Administrative Officers) specified in Table 2 shall remain in effect until March 31, 2027, and thereafter, the corresponding quota shall be deemed to be the quota of 4 positions (2 Administrative Officers, 2 Administrative Assistants) specified in Table 2.
